title: Favicon / Watch and phone examples
slide_intent: Evaluate an abbreviated mark among interface icons because people must find the brand quickly at small sizes.
strategic_value: The BK symbol can link watch and phone entry points without reproducing the full wordmark.
demonstration: A close-up watch app grid and a cropped phone screen both show the BK icon against a broad orange field.
practical_value: Compare favicon visibility among competing app icons and in an enlarged app presentation.

content_islands.name: Watch grid
content_islands.spec: Place the angled watch at left with its small BK icon among circular colored app icons.

content_islands.name: Phone screen
content_islands.spec: Crop a larger phone into the right side, showing the BK app icon and Burger King label on red.

content_islands.name: Orange field
content_islands.spec: Use the orange background to connect both device examples.

reference_purposes.Expression: The BK icon repeats its orange buns and red letterform across both screens.
reference_purposes.Application: Watch and phone mockups demonstrate the favicon in digital interfaces.
